executive.bottom_line: Ridgeview reports $12.40B regulatory AUM, 38 private funds and no Item 11 disclosures [S1]. No cohort metric is in the top quartile; the highest is AUM per adviser representative at the 62.6th percentile [S1]. Firm events are not yet published, so completeness is degraded and this is not a clean bill of health.

blocks.title: Key judgment — headline signal
blocks.text: Observation: The fictional TEST report carries one clear headline signal [S1]. Why it matters: This signal focuses oversight on the report's most decision-relevant condition. Uncertainty: Evidence coverage may exclude newer or more detailed observations. What would change the view: A governed refresh showing a different signal or breached threshold.

blocks.title: Key judgment — primary measure
blocks.text: Observation: Regulatory AUM is $12.4B in the TEST evidence [S2]. Why it matters: This measure establishes the baseline for comparing later governed results. Uncertainty: The source basis may omit newer observations outside this fixture. What would change the view: A refreshed source report showing a change above 1%.

blocks.title: Key judgment — monitoring priority
blocks.text: Observation: Composite is 32.4 in the TEST evidence [S3]. Why it matters: This result determines which item receives priority in the next monitoring cycle. Uncertainty: Supporting coverage may omit later filings or corroborating detail. What would change the view: A new filing or report that resolves the item or changes it by 1%.

items: Method: the ODD signal applies the governed Item 11, finding, alert, ownership-change and cohort-percentile rules to available evidence; unavailable evidence degrades completeness rather than becoming zero [S1] [S2] [S3].
Form ADV is adviser-reported. Gradient cohort percentiles describe positioning, not quality or performance. Form 13F is firm-level, lagged and partial [S1] [S3].
This fictional TEST report is a diligence aid, not investment, legal or compliance advice. No hire, fire, redemption, termination or allocation recommendation is made.
